{{family name hatnote|Ayala|Díaz|lang=Catalan}}
'''Josep Manel Ayala Díaz''' (born 8 April 1980) is an [[Andorra]]n international [[Association football|footballer]]. He currently plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]].<ref>[https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/58718/ayala-es-el-tercer-fitxatge-de-renom-per-a-linter-descaldes Ayala és el tercer fitxatge de renom de l'Inter d'Escaldes]</ref> Ayala formerly played for [[FC Santa Coloma]], [[US Luzenac]], [[CD Binéfar]] and [[FC Andorra]]. He made his international debut in 2002.

==International career==
Ayala was a player of [[Andorra national football team]]. He had 84<ref>{{cite web |title=Josep Ayala international statistics |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=26388 |website=eu-football.info/ |access-date=16 September 2025}}</ref> caps. His last match was the Andorran victory against [[Hungary national football team|Hungary]], the second official win in the history of the [[Andorra national football team|Andorran national team]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.que.ad/blogs/201706161936-josep-manel-ayala-futbolista.html |title=Comiat a Josep Manel Ayala de la selecció |access-date=21 August 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170816192344/http://www.que.ad/blogs/201706161936-josep-manel-ayala-futbolista.html |archive-date=16 August 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
